summary.text: 后续搜索把误差从 7 降到 3，是积极信号；一次候选无效，最终保留与改善机制仍未知。

findings.title: 后段仍有改善，值得继续研究
findings.observation: 第三次候选误差为 3，优于首次的 7；第二次候选无效。
findings.interpretation: 观察到后续改善，但未采集具体改动与配对重复，尚不能定位机制。
alternative_explanations: 随机波动可能解释部分差值；当前材料无法排除。

findings.title: 最佳结果与实际采用分别判断
findings.observation: 原始记录没有保留信息，最佳数值不能补成最终采用。
findings.interpretation: 保留结果未知；这不抹去已观测的改善。

next_experiments.question: 改善来自改动，还是随机波动？
next_experiments.why_priority: 先区分这两个解释，再决定继续投入哪条路线。
next_experiments.intervention: 从同一基线分别启用与关闭待验证的单项改动。
next_experiments.controls: 固定输入、检查点、随机序列和总计算预算，做配对重复。
next_experiments.prediction: 若改动有效，配对差值应持续改善，而非只出现单次最好值。
next_experiments.disconfirming_result: 若配对重复后差值消失或反向，应放弃该机制解释。

summary.text: Later search reduced error from 7 to 3, a positive signal. One candidate was invalid; retention and the mechanism remain unknown.

findings.title: Later improvement merits further investigation
findings.observation: Candidate three measured 3 versus the initial 7; candidate two was invalid.
findings.interpretation: Later improvement is observed, but changes and paired replications were not captured. The mechanism remains unresolved.
alternative_explanations: Random variation could explain some of the difference; these records cannot exclude it.

findings.title: Best observed and actually retained are separate
findings.observation: The source records no retention evidence.
findings.interpretation: Retention is unknown without erasing observed improvement.

next_experiments.question: Does the change help beyond random variation?
next_experiments.why_priority: Distinguish these explanations before choosing further investment.
next_experiments.intervention: Enable or disable one candidate change from the same baseline.
next_experiments.controls: Fix inputs, checkpoint, random sequence and total compute budget; use paired replications.
next_experiments.prediction: An effective change produces consistent paired gains rather than a single best value.
next_experiments.disconfirming_result: Disappearing or reversed paired differences would disconfirm the mechanism.
